fields.requirement: A single cute but threatening shambling zombie for a 2D top-down pixel roguelike. 32x32 pixel chibi character, big head small body, pale grey-green skin, hollow eyes, ragged dark brown shirt and trousers, bare hands reaching slightly forward, facing RIGHT in a three-quarter side view, feet down, full body centered with room for arm movement. Simple readable silhouette matching low-resolution RPG monsters, crisp pixels, small palette, no weapons, no gore, no text, no logo, no floor shadow, transparent background. Each output is a complete character candidate, not a spritesheet or animation sequence.
